title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Failed-Attempt Terms by Service Level
content:
When a Northgate Delivery & Installation crew cannot complete a delivery it logs a reason on its handheld. Each service level names the logged reasons that count as caused by the member, the fee for a new attempt after a member-caused failure, the number of attempts after which an undelivered appointment is cancelled, and the calendar days after a failed attempt within which a new date must be booked.

| Service level | Reasons counted as member-caused | Redelivery fee | Attempts before cancellation | Days to book a new date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Curbside Delivery | Customer not home; access blocked; item does not fit | $29.00 | 2 | 7 calendar days |
| Northgate Threshold Delivery | Customer not home; access blocked; item does not fit | $39.00 | 2 | 7 calendar days |
| Northgate Room of Choice Delivery | Customer not home; access blocked; item does not fit | $59.00 | 2 | 7 calendar days |
| Northgate White Glove Delivery | Customer not home; access blocked; item does not fit | $79.00 | 2 | 7 calendar days |
| Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation | Customer not home; access blocked; item does not fit | $79.00 | 2 | 10 calendar days |
| Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation | Customer not home; access blocked; item does not fit | $59.00 | 2 | 10 calendar days |

## Reason legend

A crew that finds nobody at the address logs customer not home. Access blocked and item does not fit are the other two reasons a crew may log that count as member-caused.

These three reasons are the member-caused reasons at every level. A reason not on this list is not a member-caused reason under this schedule.

## Notes

- Every level cancels an undelivered appointment after 2 attempts.
- The installation levels allow 10 calendar days to book a new date; the four delivery-only levels allow 7.
